clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: 1. Scope — Covers the manufacture and chemical and physical  requirements of 33 grade ordinary Portland cement.

clauses.title: Chemical Requirements
clauses.text: 2. Chemical Requirements — When tested in accordance with the methods given in IS 4032 : 1985, 33 grade ordinary Portland cement shall comply with the chemical requirements given in Table 1.

clauses.title: Fineness
clauses.text: 3.1 Fineness — Specific surface of cement shall not be less than 225 m2 /kg.

clauses.title: Soundness
clauses.text: 3.2 Soundness — Unaerated expansion shall be not more than 10 mm by 'Le Chatelier' method and 0.8 percent by autoclave test; if it fails, aerated sample shall not show more of than 5 mm and 0.6 percent when tested by 'Le Chatelier' method and autoclave method respectively.

clauses.title: Setting Time
clauses.text: 3.3 Setting Time — The setting time of the cements, when tested by the vicat apparatus shall conform to the following requirements: a)    Initial setting time Not less than in minutes 30; and b)    Final setting time Not more than in minutes 600.

clauses.title: Compressive Strength
clauses.text: 3.4 Compressive Strength — The average of at least three mortar cubes (area of face 50 cm2) composed of one part of cement, three parts of standard sand by mass and P
